svg.title: What you need to play
svg.desc: Show the seven items 1.4 lists as a checklist: players, the 36"x36" battlefield in either mode, models, markers, record sheets, resource and state tokens, and dice.

text.tspan: One battlefield in either mode. Both measure

svg.text: Schematic - not to scale; only a few squares drawn
1 miniature, standee, or token for each of these in play:
Distinguishable markers or miniatures for objectives, Treasure
Chests, hazards, scenario elements, and other temporary
Coins, paper tokens, spare miniatures, or similar markers are
sufficient. The icons here are illustrations only.
A record sheet for each Hero and party, plus
pencils or another method of recording game
Tokens for each of these, or another method of tracking each
